szenen.text: Bitcoin is down {vom_hoch} from its 90 day high. Now at {bis}.
szenen.text_ohne: Bitcoin just broke below seventy thousand dollars.

szenen.text: More than 1.3 billion dollars in crypto futures got liquidated in 24 hours. The dollar is the strongest since April 2025, and the odds of a bigger Fed hike went up.
The key line now: the 200 day average at {ema}. Bitcoin trades {ema_lage} it. A daily close below it would be a bearish signal. Holding it leaves room for a bounce. Follow for the daily close.
